name: Yuhwa
source:
A lonely young girl who has lost her family and searches for one.
When she was a child, she possessed talents strong enough to be selected by the clan, but in the main story, her abilities have ended up dropping for some reason.
She constantly pushes herself in order to protect her pride, but she's actually a timid person.

Compared to Shua, her ears feel a tad harder and her tail points up.
Ryufa herself claims that her flames are blue because of a chemical reaction, but she actually doesn't know the technical reason why.
Illusion spell types focus on hallucinations. She isn't a fan of fear spells and she has been trying hard to master charm spells, but they only work on specific types of people.

[In-game profile]
